requestSummary: Create an implementation-ready plan for safely updating both the Project Orchestrator source checkout and previously generated projects without implementing the updater.
confirmedRequirements: Cover Git-native update guidance for the Project Orchestrator Launch Pad and managed updates for previously generated projects.
Keep an unqualified project update backward compatible as a safe all-mode that updates nonconflicting assets and stops for explicit conflict choices.
Provide a complete staged design covering provenance, update modes, dependency closure, conflict policy, legacy migration, transactions, tests, documentation, rollout, and rollback.
Preserve locally enhanced skills and project-owned files unless the operator explicitly selects replacement.
Treat update-all as safe reconciliation rather than force replacement and expose force replacement as a separate explicit action.
Create planning artifacts only; do not implement code, alter skill contracts, commit, push, deploy, publish, or mutate external systems.
projectFacts: The current project updater reuses adoption transactions, backups, rollback, stale-plan checks, and verification.
The current update plan classifies every differing framework skill as update-skill and replaces that skill directory wholesale.
The existing adoption rerun test explicitly expects a locally customized framework skill to be overwritten.
Generated project manifests do not retain the base hashes or content references required for deterministic three-way comparison.
The mutable current workflow-plan view refers to an unrelated P4 continuation, while accepted execution events through sequence 32 must remain append-only.
The full repository check has one previously observed unrelated audit-checkpoint failure at tests/skill-contracts.test.mjs:1088.
assumptions: The user's autonomous response accepts the recommended scope, compatibility behavior, and complete staged-plan defaults.
Legacy managed assets without a reconstructable base are classified as unknown or customized when they differ from upstream and require an explicit operator choice.

The current workflow-plan and execution-state files are mutable current views and may point to this new plan after a new workflow-planned event is appended; prior P4 events remain authoritative history.
Interactive selection and equivalent noninteractive flags are both required so updates remain automatable.
Git remains authoritative for source-checkout updates; any Project Orchestrator helper only guides fetch, comparison, and validation.
No publication, deployment, commit, push, cloud authentication, remote mutation, or billable request is authorized.
conflicts: Publishing this plan replaces the mutable P4 current-plan and execution-state views; the prior P4 workflow remains recoverable from its accepted sequence-32 planning event and existing reports and must not be represented as completed or cancelled.

questions.question: Should the plan cover both the Launch Pad checkout and previously generated projects?
questions.answer: Autonomous default accepted: both update surfaces

questions.question: What should an unqualified existing pso update command do after this change?
questions.answer: Autonomous default accepted: safe all mode

questions.answer: Autonomous default accepted: complete staged design
